entities.summary: Zayn al-Dīn Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Shahrāshūb, more commonly known simply as Ibn Shahrāshūb, sometimes nicknamed as Rashīd al-Dīn and ʿIzz al-Dīn, died 1192, was a 12th century Shia Muslim scholar, commentator and jurist of Iranian descent.
